channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2013-3346 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Adobe Reader and Acrobat contain a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2015-3043 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A memory corruption vulnerability exists in Adobe Flash Player that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2016-1019 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service or possibly execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2022-20699 — Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 74. A vulnerability in Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers could allow an attacker to do any of the following: Execute arbitrary code elevate privileges, execute arbitrary commands, bypass authentication and authorization protections, fetch and run unsigned software, or cause a denial of service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2013-3897 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 73. A use-after-free vulnerability exists within CDisplayPointer in Microsoft Internet Explorer that allows an attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2017-6736 — Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code.

item.title: CVE-2013-1347 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 74. This vulnerability may corrupt memory in a way that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user within Internet Explorer.

item.title: CVE-2013-0625 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Adobe Coldfusion contains an authentication bypass vulnerability, which could result in an unauthorized user gaining administrative access.

item.title: CVE-2020-1938 — Apache Tomcat
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Apache Tomcat treats Apache JServ Protocol (AJP) connections as having higher trust than, for example, a similar HTTP connection. If such connections are available to an attacker, they can be exploited.

item.title: CVE-2015-5119 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 80. A use-after-free vulnerability exists within the ActionScript 3 ByteArray class in Adobe Flash Player that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-8540 — Microsoft Malware Protection Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 70. The Microsoft Malware Protection Engine running on Microsoft Forefront and Microsoft Defender on Microsoft Windows Server 2008 SP2 and R2 SP1, Windows 7 SP1, Windows 8.1, Windows Server 2012 Gold and R2, Windows RT 8.1, Windows 10 Gold, 1511, 1607, and 1703, and Windows Server 2016, Microsoft Exchange Server 2013 and 2016, does not properly scan a specially crafted file leading to memory corruption. aka "Microsoft Malware Protection Engine Remote Code Execution Vulnerability".

item.title: CVE-2017-11826 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Office software when the software fails to properly handle objects in memory. An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could run arbitrary code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2017-0261 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Office contains a use-after-free vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-4114 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A vulnerability exists in Windows Object Linking & Embedding (OLE) that could allow remote code execution if a user opens a file that contains a specially crafted OLE object.

item.title: CVE-2019-16928 — Exim Exim Internet Mailer
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Exim contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-8581 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Microsoft Exchange Server. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could attempt to impersonate any other user of the Exchange server.

item.title: CVE-2018-8298 — ChakraCore ChakraCore scripting engine

item.title: CVE-2017-6744 — Cisco IOS software
item.description: Threat Signal 59. The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS 1 contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code on an affected system or cause an affected system to reload. An attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by sending a crafted SNMP packet to an affected system via IPv4 or IPv6.

item.title: CVE-2018-0167 — Cisco IOS, XR, and XE Software
item.description: Threat Signal 59. There is a buffer overflow vulnerability in the Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) subsystem of Cisco IOS Software, Cisco IOS XE Software, and Cisco IOS XR Software which could allow an unauthenticated, adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) condition or execute arbitrary code.
